items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He did all his writing. Maybe one or two things I wrote for, but not many things.

ctx.x: Yeah. They really don’t ask me to do nothing “outside.” It’s always something like a original or one of their tunes, and it’s a great honor – Monk.
What about Diana Ross? How was she? That was at Motown?
